title: Recording: She’s My Baby by Wings | 1976
content:
Studio Two, Abbey Road Studios, London
Producer: Paul McCartney
Engineer: Peter Henderson

Wings continued work on the Wings At The Speed Of Sound song ‘She’s My Baby’ on 8 January 1976.

They had recorded 35 takes the day before, the last of which was marked best. Paul McCartney had overdubbed a lead vocals part, but decided it could be bettered.

On this day he recorded several more attempts to nail the part. The tape was slowed down to lower the pitch, which meant his vocals were higher and faster upon playback. He then added an electric guitar part.

The session ended with rough mixes made of several album outtakes: ‘Rode All Night’, ‘Great Cock And Seagull Race’, ‘A Love For You’, ‘Jazz Street’, ‘Wide Prairie’, and ‘Oriental Nightfish’, plus the October 1975 recordings of ‘The Note You Never Wrote’ and ‘Beware My Love’.
